title: Inspecting and Managing Running Processes
instructions: Answer from the lesson. For short-answer and practical items, equivalent technically correct wording/code earns credit.

questions.prompt: What is the usual intent of SIGTERM?
questions.explanation: SIGTERM allows a process to clean up before exiting.

questions.prompt: Why confirm PID and command before killing a process?

options.text: To avoid terminating the wrong process

questions.explanation: Process IDs can be reused or misidentified; confirm target identity.

questions.prompt: Name three useful process details to inspect.
questions.expected_answer: Any three relevant fields with an explanation are acceptable.

questions.prompt: A development server hangs. Outline a safe sequence before using SIGKILL.
questions.expected_answer: Safe process management prefers diagnosis and graceful shutdown first.

questions.prompt: Why must command availability be considered across Linux and macOS?
questions.expected_answer: Portable instructions should state platform assumptions or offer alternatives.
